privatePromptTestsUi.title: Private prompt execution test
privatePromptTestsUi.boundary: This is a separate execution that sends data to an external model and may incur charges. It does not select, promote or publish a revision. Private access controls are not an Agent, CLI or filesystem sandbox.
privatePromptTestsUi.profile: Supported profile only: built-in Claude CLI bare mode with an explicitly configured, fixed-version company-vault API key, legacy/local/fresh execution; no Paperclip token, runtime tools, MCP or bridge. Subscription login, overrides, ACP/native, remote and resumed sessions are unsupported; there is no fallback.
privatePromptTestsUi.contextBoundary: The preparation ticket binds the fixed Agent configuration, revision and dataset case to an approval digest. Derived execution configuration has a hash witness only; this is not a complete capture or prior approval of all hidden model context.
privatePromptTestsUi.confirmProfile: I approve the restricted API-key profile without Paperclip tools. This does not authorize switching a subscription account to API billing.
privatePromptTestsUi.confirmExecution: I separately authorize one real execution of this prepared ticket and its fixed approval digest.
privatePromptTestsUi.confirmCharges: I understand that this sends data to an external model and may incur charges.
privatePromptTestsUi.order: Pages use UUID order, not chronology. Refresh to read the latest recorded state.
privatePromptTestsUi.disabled: Execution is disabled or this profile is unavailable. An operator must enable the server execution gate and configure a supported Agent profile; this page never enables it automatically.
privatePromptTestsUi.readFailed: Private data is hidden because this read failed or administrator access expired. Refresh after restoring access.
privatePromptTestsUi.saved: A verified operation receipt was recorded. Pending execution remains locked to this ticket until a matching terminal state. No new execution is started automatically.
privatePromptTestsUi.unknown: The operation outcome is uncertain. This tab retains only non-secret identity metadata, not prompt text, credentials or results. Refresh revalidates access and binding; it never posts automatically. Awaiting confirmation cannot rule out a delayed Execute: retry only this same ID or atomically cancel it. Closing the tab is not covered.
privatePromptTestsUi.conflict: The head or request binding changed. Review current registry state and all references before confirming again.
privatePromptTestsUi.rejected: The server rejected this request. Verify the enabled profile, permissions and fixed references before confirming again.
privatePromptTestsUi.preparedBoundary: Prepared records a hash of the final prompt. It does not prove process spawn, stdin delivery or provider consumption.
privatePromptTestsUi.spawnedBoundary: A process spawn was recorded. This is not proof that the provider consumed the prompt.
privatePromptTestsUi.completedBoundary: Completed means this adapter execution ended with a usable result. It does not prove correctness, provider consumption or publication approval.
privatePromptTestsUi.resultBoundary: Private, bounded adapter result only. Full stdout/stderr and complete model context are not available. Text is displayed inertly.
privatePromptTestsUi.resultUnavailable: No complete private result is available for this state. Unknown or failed execution must not be retried automatically.
privatePromptTestsUi.textOnlyBoundary: Text-only prompt experiment: requires a complete, non-empty SKILL.md and explicitly UTF-8, non-executable text snapshots; skill scripts, tools, binaries and assets are not executed. Only case input is sent, never the expected answer. The literal revision, fixed skill text and case input together must not exceed 256000 UTF-8 bytes; oversized input is rejected, not truncated.
privatePromptTestsUi.twoPhase: First prepare a metadata-only ticket with a fixed approval digest: preparation never executes or charges a model. Review the returned binding, then separately authorize Execute or atomically cancel the ticket.
privatePromptTestsUi.ticketReady: Ticket prepared without execution. Review its fixed references and approval digest before separately confirming Execute.
privatePromptTestsUi.storageFailed: This tab cannot reliably retain the pending operation marker. No execution request will be sent. Restore session storage, then refresh; do not delete an unresolved marker.
privatePromptTestsUi.snapshotTitle: Server-saved approval snapshot — not current Agent settings
privatePromptTestsUi.snapshotTarget: Configured working directory (not the final execution directory)
privatePromptTestsUi.snapshotEnvironment: Target driver / selection source / environment ID
privatePromptTestsUi.snapshotCredential: Pinned company secret reference / version (not its value)
privatePromptTestsUi.snapshotRestrictions: This saved profile requires a fresh session, disables tools and Paperclip credentials, and does not capture complete context. It does not authorize later Agent configuration changes.
privatePromptTestsUi.snapshotUnavailable: This historical record has no validated approval snapshot. It is read-only; execution cannot be authorized.
privatePromptTestsUi.snapshotCwdUnresolved: Resolved at runtime — not determined yet
privatePromptTestsUi.abandonPrepareBoundary: This only forgets a metadata-only preparation in this tab. It does not cancel a server ticket; a ticket awaiting separate execution approval may remain. No model execution was authorized by Prepare.
privatePromptTestsUi.prepareAbandoned: Local preparation forgotten. Edit the references, then explicitly prepare a new ticket if needed. No server cancellation or execution was requested.

promptApplicationsUi.title: Controlled application to one agent
promptApplicationsUi.boundary: Off by default. Preparing and approving a binding does not wake an agent, start a model, authorize charges or send anything externally. Registry selection remains separate.
promptApplicationsUi.profile: Initial support: built-in Claude CLI, local environment, explicitly pinned company API-key version. Subscription, native, ACP, router, remote and configuration overlays are rejected, never silently converted.
promptApplicationsUi.scope: Only tasks created after approval, with no project, at their first fresh dispatch. Existing tasks, resumed sessions, retries, recovery and later wakes do not inherit this binding. The revision is appended literally; existing templates and instructions are not replaced. A later continuation may still retain the prompt already introduced in the session; rollback cannot erase that history.
promptApplicationsUi.visibility: Not private execution: prompt text may reach ordinary run logs, authorized tools, outputs, task comments and artifacts, and their authorized readers. Secret redaction does not keep prompt text private.
promptApplicationsUi.disabled: Application is disabled or has not been verified. No runtime binding can be approved here yet.
promptApplicationsUi.evidenceReady: An explicitly selected historical comparison is ready. Preparation revalidates its exact evidence and target.
promptApplicationsUi.evidenceNeeded: Compare historical tests above, then choose “Use for application review”. This does not prepare or approve anything automatically.
promptApplicationsUi.expiryBoundary: The deadline applies only to approving this proposal. A configured binding does not expire after 60 minutes; it remains until explicit rollback, with drift and permission checks at dispatch.
promptApplicationsUi.contextBoundary: Incomplete model context: this snapshot binds configuration and implementation, not complete model context. Private bare comparison is not proof of ordinary tool-enabled quality.
promptApplicationsUi.confirmOrdinaryVisibility: I accept the ordinary logs, tools, outputs, comments and artifact visibility described above.
promptApplicationsUi.confirmBareComparisonNotToolQuality: I understand that private bare comparison does not prove ordinary tool-enabled quality.
promptApplicationsUi.confirmNewTasksOnly: I confirm this one agent, the fixed revision and scope: new projectless tasks, first fresh dispatch only.
promptApplicationsUi.confirmNoAutomaticRun: I understand this configures a binding only; it does not start execution or authorize charges or external actions.
promptApplicationsUi.confirmRollback: Withdraw only this current binding for future eligible dispatches. Keep other agent configuration and secrets unchanged. This does not stop existing runs, release their leases, or undo past tool effects.
promptApplicationsUi.dispatchBoundary: Configured is not dispatched. A prepared receipt without a dispatch witness does not establish delivery of this literal to model stdin; ordinary metadata and logs may already contain the prompt. A dispatched receipt does not prove provider consumption. No receipt is not proof of no disclosure or execution.
promptApplicationsUi.inputUnconfirmed: Delivery to model stdin is unconfirmed
promptApplicationsUi.inputNotApplied: This literal was not delivered to model stdin
promptApplicationsUi.inputDispositionBoundary: A not-applied-before-input witness proves only that this literal was withheld from model stdin. Ordinary metadata or logs may already contain the prompt, and CLI-start effects may have occurred. Existing runs may continue; stopped status is unconfirmed. This does not stop runs or release their leases.
promptApplicationsUi.recover: Check the same request — read only
promptApplicationsUi.prepared: Proposal prepared, not configured. Inspect the current target, review the fixed digests and confirm all four boundaries before approving.
promptApplicationsUi.configured: A configuration receipt was recorded; it may be historical. No wake or execution was started by this action. Refresh to check the current binding and actual dispatch receipts.
promptApplicationsUi.rolledBack: Binding rolled back for future eligible dispatches. Other configuration and past effects are unchanged.
promptApplicationsUi.failed: Cannot verify this view. Private details were cleared. Check access and refresh; do not assume application succeeded.
promptApplicationsUi.storageFailed: Safe request metadata could not be stored or verified. Writes are blocked; do not clear storage to retry an uncertain action.
promptApplicationsUi.unknown: The write outcome is unknown. New requests are blocked. Query the same ID first; only an explicit, freshly confirmed retry may resend the identical request.
promptApplicationsUi.unresolved: No durable result is visible yet. This does not cancel a delayed write. Keep the request ID; query again or explicitly review and retry the exact request.
promptApplicationsUi.conflict: Target changed, evidence drifted, or execution is active. Nothing was overwritten. Stop active work separately if needed, then inspect current state and review a new proposal.
promptApplicationsUi.rejected: The server rejected this proposal or action. Check the supported profile, permissions and fixed evidence; nothing was silently converted.
promptApplicationsUi.noDispatches: No actual dispatch receipts are recorded for this application.
promptApplicationsUi.reviewRetry: Review the original proposal for an explicit retry
promptApplicationsUi.confirmRetry: I explicitly authorize resending this exact request ID and fixed payload, not creating a replacement. An existing success will only return its prior receipt.
promptApplicationsUi.retrySameRequest: Retry this exact request — never a new ID
promptApplicationsUi.abandonPrepareBoundary: Preparation never applies a binding or runs a model. This only removes local recovery metadata; a delayed server proposal may still be created and can appear in history. It does not cancel or approve that proposal. Never use this for uncertain approval or rollback.
promptApplicationsUi.abandonedPrepare: Local preparation recovery was abandoned. A server proposal may still exist, but no approval or execution was authorized.
promptApplicationsUi.notAppliedClosed: The server has proven this request was not applied and can no longer apply at its fixed generation or approval deadline. Local recovery is closed; inspect current state before making a new proposal.
promptApplicationsUi.credentialVersions: Pinned company credential IDs / versions (not secret values)
promptApplicationsUi.proposalVisibility: Preparing a proposal stores deployment metadata visible to this company’s authorized owners and administrators, including revision, dataset and test IDs and the cost cap. Private case text, results and prompt contents are not included in this metadata.
promptApplicationsUi.workspacePolicyBoundary: When a new projectless task resolves to managed agent_home metadata, built-in Claude follows its existing rule and runs in the approved fixed configuration cwd. The actual process directory must match that approved cwd and be bound into the effective context hash; the managed workspace metadata is checked separately for ownership. Different tasks may share files in this directory: there is no per-task directory isolation. Rollback does not clear historical files or sessions.

promptRegistryUi.title: Prompt registry
promptRegistryUi.boundary: Registry selection alone never applies agent files, model configuration or runtime changes. Private execution tests require separate explicit authorization. Do not store credentials.

runtimeCostRoutingUi.boundary: Default off. Only a human owner or administrator can prepare and approve an explicit candidate pool. Saving or approving never starts a task.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.profile: Qualification: bare_text_proxy_v1 · ordinaryToolsQualityProven: false · completeContextCaptured: false
runtimeCostRoutingUi.historyCost: Reported USD is historical evidence, not a future quote, spending cap, or guarantee of ordinary tool quality.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.privacy: Policy metadata is visible to authorized company owners and administrators. Do not paste private cases, inputs, outputs, prompts, or secrets here. New tasks use ordinary company visibility; private proof text is never copied.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.unsupported: Only explicitly tested built-in local Claude candidates with pinned API-key credentials are supported. Missing evidence, wrong identities, unknown or unsettled costs cannot be overridden by a checkbox.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.defaultOff: Runtime routing is disabled by the server feature flag. Metadata and disable controls remain available.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.paused: The company is paused. Preparation, approval, new tasks and runs are blocked; you can still inspect metadata or disable the policy.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.error: The request could not be verified. Refresh authorized metadata or read back the pending request before trying again.

runtimeCostRoutingUi.prepared: Proposal prepared. No task or run was started.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.approved: Policy approved. No task or run was started.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.disabledPolicy: Future routing disabled. Existing runs were not cancelled.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.disableBoundary: Disable changes future policy use only. It does not cancel an accepted run, reverse provider fees, or undo external effects.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmBare: I accept the limited bare-text proxy; ordinary tool quality is not proven.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmHistorical: I understand that historical reported USD is not a future price or spending cap.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmNew: I approve only new, projectless tasks and their first fresh run; no fallback to another candidate or old task.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmNoRun: I understand that policy approval does not start execution.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmAudience: I understand the policy metadata audience and ordinary task visibility.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmDisable: I understand that disabling does not cancel accepted runs or fees.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.blocked: Evidence blocked — confirmations cannot make it eligible.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.proposalExpired: This proposal is expired or no longer matches the current generation. Prepare a new proposal.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.taskVisibility: This creates an ordinary company-visible task. Enter intended work, not private evaluation cases or credentials. Editing its content after binding blocks the first run.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmTask: I confirm that this new task may be visible to the company.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.createTask: Create new bound task — do not run
runtimeCostRoutingUi.taskCreated: New task bound to one candidate. Execution has not been requested.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmRun: Start this bound task now; provider fees and external effects may occur.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.runBoundary: Running is a separate action. The server rechecks authorization, policy, evidence, configuration and budgets. Failure never switches candidates or resumes an old task.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.runRequested: Run request recorded. This is not proof that the model started, consumed input or completed successfully.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.unknown: The write outcome is unknown. Its request ID is retained; do not create a replacement or assume that an HTTP error means nothing happened.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.unresolved: No terminal outcome is proven. The pending request is retained.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.closed: The server confirmed that this request is closed without applying it.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmRetry: I reviewed the latest readback and authorize only the exact same request and payload.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.retryUnavailable: Exact task content is not retained after leaving this view. Read back the request; do not recreate it while its outcome is unknown.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.storageFailed: Recovery metadata could not be stored and verified. Mutations are blocked; keep this page open and check browser storage.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.notAuthorized: Current owner or administrator access could not be verified. Private metadata is hidden.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.proxyThresholdNotMet: Excluded by the bare proxy quality threshold
runtimeCostRoutingUi.boundPolicyInactive: The bound policy is inactive or has changed. This task cannot switch to another candidate.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.bindingUnavailable: The previous task binding could not be read. Current policy access was checked again; you can still disable future routing.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.previousSessionPending: A request from your earlier sign-in is still unresolved. Readback only: its confirmations and execution intent were not transferred.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.closeExpired: Verify and close the expired, unapplied proposal
runtimeCostRoutingUi.confirmCloseExpired: I authorize only permanently closing this expired, never-applied proposal. This does not approve a policy, cancel a run, or reverse charges.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.closeExpiredBoundary: First read back the pending approval. The server checks expiry and refuses to close an active or previously approved proposal. The original request stays pending until an authorized readback proves its outcome.
runtimeCostRoutingUi.bindingWitnessBoundary: These routing records are not the task’s current run status. They do not prove that the model consumed input or completed successfully. Open the task to inspect progress, errors and results.
